Filters with Hashtags not working
I think we had this issue in the past, but here it is again. :)

A filter for a hastag:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42511384/183861683-31fb6792-6346-46dd-a9e9-cf9dc172388c.png)

It works in web:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42511384/183861808-7196af5e-7734-49d6-b64a-557fb2abfb42.png)

but not in the app:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42511384/183862106-4d623a37-4e06-4851-bf80-5d67c1b555e1.png)

Things I've tried:

- Restarting the phone
- Restarting the app (force stop & cache delete)
- Deleting and recreating the filter
- Turning the "whole word" option on and off

* * * *
- Tusky Version: Tusky 19.0
- Android Version: 12
- Android Device: Samsung S21
- Mastodon instance (if applicable):

- [X] I searched or browsed the repo’s other (open) issues to ensure this is not a duplicate.
